doc: Hero motion tuning (M2-HER-1101..1104, ADR 0190): how the real hero models turn, blend their gait and idle in the field, in battle and in cutscenes. Metres, seconds, degrees. Read by HeroLocomotion (game/hero_motion/hero_locomotion.gd).

turn.doc: The visible body turns toward its travel (or its node's facing when still) at most max_rate_deg_per_sec, never snapping. The turn speed eases in (max_accel) and out (settle_gain: degrees per second per degree of error left).

gait.doc: Locomotion blend (BlendSpace1D on ground speed): idle at 0, walk at walk_clip_mps, run at run_clip_mps, the speeds at which each in-place clip's feet plant without sliding (Rhen's, measured; the field heroes override them per hero in field.heroes). Above run the clip speeds up to max_playback_scale. speed_smoothing_sec filters the speed the blend sees, so a start or stop rolls through the gait instead of popping.

field.doc: Field bodies (M2-HER-1101/1102): HeroFieldActor puts a hero model on the FieldController (the party leader) and on CutsceneStage Actors/<hero id> capsules; HeroFieldParty walks the other joined heroes on the leader's trail. Each hero's walk_clip_mps / run_clip_mps override 'gait' (measured by HeroClipGait with gait_measure; tests/unit/test_hero_field_actor.gd checks them within measure_tolerance). model_yaw_offset_deg turns the model (it faces +Z) onto the field's forward (-Z); ground_offset_m lifts it off the node's origin (its feet). standin_names are the capsule visuals hidden under a body (anything else, such as a lantern, stays). locomotion_clips are the BlendSpace1D clips: play_clip of one of them returns to locomotion; clip_blend_sec is play_clip's default cross-fade.

gait_measure.doc: HeroClipGait: each bone is in contact while within contact_tol_m of its lowest height in the cycle; its backward speed then (mean over every contact sample of every bone, sampled `samples` times a cycle) is the clip's ground speed. The data above must match it within measure_tolerance (a fraction).

followers.doc: HeroFieldParty: at most `max` followers (party order, the leader excluded) walk the leader's breadcrumb trail (a crumb every trail_sample_m, at most trail_max_points), follower i at (i + 1) * spacing_m of trail behind the leader. Each steers to its trail point at up to max_speed_mps, faster the bigger the gap (follow_gain per second), accelerating at accel_mps2 and braking at decel_mps2, and never closer than min_gap_m to the body ahead. Further than catch_up_m from its point (a zone load, a long jump, the end of a cutscene) it is put on the trail at once. A ray from ray_up_m above to ray_down_m below its point sets its feet on the floor. rescan_sec: how often the zone is searched again for cutscene stages and sequencers.
